title: 第3100章 真正惊骇第3099章 接我一剑
slug: 剑里乾坤第3107章不似作伪
content_zh:
厉抗天面色骤变，素来阴鸷的眼底第一次闪过一丝惊惧，如万年寒冰裂开细缝。
他手腕急转，万蛊刀在身前舞成密不透风的墨绿刀网，每一缕刀光都裹挟着百毒凶煞，同时身形暴退，黑袍在山风中猎猎作响，如展开的幽冥幡旗。
刀网与银白剑影接连碰撞，叮叮当当的金铁交鸣如骤雨击石，火星如暴雨般飞溅，在幽暗的崖顶织成一片璀璨的光网。
五道剑影被刀网绞碎，化作漫天光点消散，然而剩余四道剑影却如穿云利箭，突破层层防御，擦着他的黑袍掠过——一声，黑袍下摆被斩得粉碎，如枯蝶般在风中飘散，更凌厉的剑气直接在他胸前划开四道浅浅的血痕，黑血珠滚落衣襟，触之处衣料瞬间腐蚀出黑洞。
厉抗天踉跄后退数步，脚掌碾过岩石发出刺耳的摩擦声，方才稳住身形。
他低头瞥了眼胸前血痕，又抬眼望向卓然手中那柄仍在嗡鸣的红云白龙剑，剑脊上赤银二色流转，似有龙息吞吐。
眼中战意与忌惮交织如乱麻，崖顶之上山风呼啸，卷起两人衣袂，一时对峙无言，虽未分生死，厉抗天那股睥睨天下的气势却已泄了三分，显露出几分颓势。
忽然，厉抗天伸出枯瘦如鬼爪的手指，蘸了蘸胸前的黑血，缓缓送入口中。
舌尖舔过唇角的瞬间，眼中那丝忌惮竟如退潮般消散，取而代之的是一抹近乎癫狂的炽热，仿佛点燃了八十年的执念。
好……好得很！
他骤然仰天大笑，笑声如夜枭啼鸣，尖锐刺耳，震得崖顶碎石簌簌滚落，坠入深渊发出沉闷的回响，四十年前，太虚老鬼以剑里乾坤胜我半招，今日他的徒弟竟以云龙九现伤我肌肤——这是天意，是要让我了却这桩宿怨！
笑声戛然而止，他墨绿色的瞳孔骤然收缩如针，周身黑袍无风自动，猎猎作响如战旗鼓荡。
一股磅礴如海的内力自他丹田处轰然爆发，崖顶之上的空气仿佛被一只无形巨手狠狠攥住，粘稠得几乎让人窒息，连山风都为之一滞，绕着两人回旋不去。
小子，你确实妖孽。
厉抗天声音沙哑如磨铁，却如闷雷滚过天际，震得人耳膜嗡嗡作响，什么只比武技？什么公平之争？江湖之上，成王败寇，哪来那么多迂腐规矩！
他一步踏出，脚下岩石一声裂出蛛网般的纹路，碎石竟被那股雄浑内力震得悬浮半空，如受无形之力牵引。
八十年苦修的修罗阴煞功如决堤洪水般倾泻而出，周身黑雾翻涌沸腾，竟在他身后凝成一道三丈高的修罗虚影——青面獠牙，双目燃着绿火，手持一柄巨刀，周身缠绕着无数冤魂虚影，威势骇人，仿佛要将整个崖顶拖入九幽地狱！
老夫苦修八十载的修罗阴煞功，今日便让你这小辈见识见识，什么叫真正的——
内力如山！
话音未落，厉抗天身形已如出膛炮弹般暴射而出，万蛊刀裹挟着排山倒海的阴煞内力，化作一道墨绿闪电当头劈下！

这一刀与先前截然不同，刀未至，那股如山岳倾覆般的威压已让卓然周身骨骼发出的轻响，仿佛要被碾碎；脚下坚硬的岩石寸寸龟裂，蛛网般的裂痕迅速蔓延开丈许。
卓然瞳孔骤缩如豆，体内内力还没来得及运行，厉抗天德刀就已经到了头顶。
他本能的将红云白龙剑横架于顶，手腕翻转间，赤银二色光华暴涨——
铛！
一声巨响如洪钟大吕撞破苍穹，震得下方众人气血翻涌，修为稍弱者竟当场喷出一口鲜血，连站立都难以支撑；远处山峦间传来阵阵回音，如千军万马奔腾而过。
卓然只觉一股无可抵御的巨力自剑身传来，双臂瞬间麻木失去知觉，整个人如断线风筝般倒飞出去，后背重重撞在崖壁之上，地喷出一口血雾，将身前丈许的岩石染得一片猩红！
卓然！
水月心不顾左臂伤口崩裂渗血，挣扎着起身，玉扇地展开，便要冲上崖顶。
别过来！
卓然以剑撑地，艰难站起，抹去嘴角血迹，胸口剧烈起伏，眼中却闪过一丝奇异的亮色。
他体内玉眼赤蛟内丹感受到那股阴煞内力的侵袭，竟如沉睡万年的蛟龙被激怒，猛然苏醒——一股灼热如岩浆、霸道如雷霆的气息自丹田深处轰然涌出，顺着他周身经脉狂飙突进，所过之处，那阴寒刺骨的煞力如冰雪遇沸汤，瞬间消融无踪！
厉抗天一击得手，正欲乘胜追击，却见卓然周身竟泛起淡淡的赤金色光晕，如旭日初升破开阴霾，将周遭黑雾驱散得干干净净。
他心头猛地一跳，脚步不由自主地顿住——那光晕中蕴含的阳刚霸道之气，竟让他体内修炼八十年的阴煞功力生出一种本能的畏惧，如鼠见猫，如羊遇狼，连运转都变得滞涩起来！
这是……厉抗天枯瘦的面皮剧烈抽搐，眼中第一次浮现出真正的惊骇，仿佛见了鬼一般，这是什么力量？！
卓然缓缓挺直身躯，赤金色光晕愈发炽烈，将他整个人笼罩其中，如披了一件烈焰战甲，连须发都染上一层金芒。
他手中红云白龙剑感应到主人内力的蜕变，剑身赤银二色光芒轰然暴涨，交织成一道贯穿天地的光柱，龙吟之声震彻九霄，竟引动天际云层翻涌！
厉抗天，你以为八十年的功力便能吃定我？卓然声音低沉，却如龙吟虎啸，在崖顶之上回荡不休，带着焚尽一切的霸气，今天便让你知道，什么才是真正的霸道！
什么才叫碾压！
他一步踏出，脚下岩石竟被那股灼热气息熔出浅浅的凹坑，碎石遇热化作赤红岩浆，作响。
厉抗天只觉一股焚山煮海的劲风扑面而来，竟比他全力施展的阴煞功还要炽烈三分，逼得他下意识后仰躲闪！

不可能！
厉抗天厉喝一声，强行压下心头惊惧，八十年的功力催谷至巅峰，万蛊刀化作一道墨绿长虹，裹挟着漫天毒雾，直刺卓然心口，老夫不信！
纵使你有奇遇，还能抵得过我八十年苦修的根基？！
content_en:
Li Kangtian's expression suddenly changed, and for the first time a hint of fear flashed through his usually sinister eyes, like thin cracks opening in ten thousand years of ice.
He turned his wrist sharply, and the ten thousand Gu knives danced in front of him into an airtight network of dark green knives. Every ray of sword light was wrapped with hundreds of poisons and evil spirits. At the same time, his body retreated violently, and the black robes made a hunting sound in the mountain wind, like unfurled banners of the underworld.
The knife net collided with the silver-white sword shadow one after another, the jingling gold and iron jingled like a shower hitting rocks, and sparks flew like a rainstorm, weaving a bright network of light on the dark cliff top.
The five sword shadows were crushed by the knife net, turning into light spots all over the sky and dissipating. However, the remaining four sword shadows were like sharp arrows piercing the clouds, breaking through the layers of defense and passing by his black robe - with a sound, the hem of the black robe was chopped to pieces and scattered in the wind like a withered butterfly. The sharper sword energy directly cut four shallow blood marks on his chest. Black blood beads rolled down the skirt of his clothes, and black holes were instantly corroded in the fabric where they touched.
Li Kangtian staggered back a few steps, his feet making a harsh friction sound as he ran over the rocks, before he stabilized his body.
He lowered his head and glanced at the blood marks on his chest, then raised his eyes to look at the red cloud and white dragon sword that was still humming in Zhuo Ran's hand. The red and silver colors flowed on the sword's spine, as if there was a dragon's breath breathing out.
The fighting spirit and fear intertwined in his eyes like a tangled mess. The mountain wind roared on the top of the cliff and rolled up the clothes of the two people. They were silent for a moment. Although they did not distinguish between life and death, Li Kangtian's aura of looking down on the world had already been released, showing some signs of decline.
Suddenly, Li Kangtian stretched out his fingers as thin as ghost claws, dipped the black blood on his chest, and slowly brought it into his mouth.
The moment the tip of his tongue licked the corner of his lips, the trace of fear in his eyes dissipated like an ebbing tide, replaced by an almost crazy heat, as if igniting eighty years of obsession.
Good...very good!
He suddenly looked up to the sky and laughed, his laughter was like the cry of a night owl, sharp and harsh, causing the rocks on the cliff top to roll down, and falling into the abyss with a dull echo. Forty years ago, the old ghost Taixu defeated me with half a move of the sword. Today, his apprentice actually hurt my skin with the Nine Manifestations of Cloud Dragon - this is God's will, he wants me to settle this old grudge!
The laughter stopped suddenly, and his dark green pupils suddenly shrank like needles. The black robe around him moved automatically without any wind, and the hunting sound was like a war flag.
A majestic sea of ​​internal energy burst out from his Dantian. The air above the cliff top seemed to be tightly grasped by an invisible giant hand. It was so sticky that it was almost suffocating. Even the mountain wind was stagnant and could not circle around the two of them.
Boy, you are indeed a monster.
Li Kangtian's voice was as hoarse as grinding iron, but it was like muffled thunder rolling across the sky, making people's eardrums buzz. What's just a competition of martial arts? What fair fight? In the world of rivers and lakes, where the winner is the king and the loser is the bandit, how come there are so many pedantic rules!
He took one step forward, and the rock under his feet cracked with spiderweb-like lines. The gravel was suspended in mid-air by the powerful internal force, as if being pulled by an invisible force.
Eighty years of hard training in the Shura Yin Sha Kung poured out like a flood. The black mist around him surged and boiled, and actually formed a three-foot-tall Shura shadow behind him - a green face with fangs, eyes burning with green fire, holding a giant knife, and surrounded by countless ghosts of wronged souls. The power was terrifying, as if it was dragging the entire top of the cliff into the Nine Nether Hells!
I have been practicing the Shura Yin Sha Kung for eighty years, and today I will let you, a junior, see what the real thing is -
Internal strength is like a mountain!
Before he finished speaking, Li Kangtian's body shot out like a cannonball, and the Wan Gu knife, packed with overwhelming Yin evil internal energy, turned into a dark green lightning and struck down on his head!
This knife was completely different from the previous one. Before the knife came, the pressure like a mountain toppling had already made Zhuo Ran's bones make a soft sound, as if they were about to be crushed; the hard rock under his feet was cracked inch by inch, and the spider web-like cracks quickly spread for several feet.
Zhuoran's pupils suddenly shrank like beans, and before the internal force in his body had time to operate, Li Kangtiande's sword had already reached the top of his head.
He instinctively placed the Red Cloud White Dragon Sword horizontally on top of his head. When he flipped his wrist, the red and silver brilliance skyrocketed——
Bang!
A loud sound like a bellDa Lu crashed into the sky, shaking the energy and blood of everyone below. The weaker ones spurted out a mouthful of blood on the spot, and could not even stand up; there were echoes from the mountains in the distance, like thousands of troops galloping past.
Zhuo Ran only felt an irresistible force coming from the sword. His arms were instantly numb and he lost consciousness. He flew backwards like a kite with a broken string. His back hit the cliff heavily, and a mouthful of blood mist was sprayed out from the ground, dyeing the rocks about ten feet in front of him crimson!
Zhuoran!
Regardless of the cracked and bleeding wound on her left arm, Shui Yuexin struggled to get up, spread out her jade fan, and rushed to the top of the cliff.
Don't come here!
Zhuo Ran propped his sword on the ground, stood up with difficulty, wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, his chest heaved violently, but a strange light flashed in his eyes.
The jade-eyed red dragon inner alchemy in his body felt the invasion of the sinister inner force, and he was like a dragon that had been sleeping for thousands of years being angered and suddenly awakening - a breath as hot as magma and as domineering as thunder burst out from the depths of his dantian and surged along the meridians around his body. Wherever it passed, the cold and biting evil force melted away without a trace in an instant like ice and snow meeting boiling soup!
Li Kangtian succeeded with a strike and was about to take advantage of the victory when he saw a faint red-gold halo glowing around Zhuoran, like the rising sun breaking through the haze and dispersing the surrounding black fog.
His heart skipped a beat and his steps stopped involuntarily - the masculine and domineering energy contained in the halo actually caused the eighty years of Yin evil power in his body to create an instinctive fear, like a mouse seeing a cat, like a sheep meeting a wolf, and even his movements became stagnant!
This is... Li Kangtian's skinny face twitched violently, and for the first time real horror appeared in his eyes, as if he had seen a ghost. What kind of power is this? !
Zhuoran slowly straightened his body, and the red-gold halo became more intense, covering his whole body, as if he was wearing a blazing armor, and even his beard and hair were dyed with a layer of golden light.
The red cloud and white dragon sword in his hand sensed the transformation of the master's inner power, and the red and silver lights on the sword suddenly surged, intertwining into a beam of light that penetrated the sky and the earth. The sound of the dragon's roar shook the sky, causing the clouds in the sky to surge!
Li Kangtian, do you think eighty years of skill can defeat me? Zhuoran's voice is low, but like the roar of a dragon and the roar of a tiger, it echoes endlessly on the top of the cliff, with a domineering aura that burns everything. Today I will let you know what true domineering is!
What does crushing mean?
He took one step forward, and the rocks under his feet were melted into shallow pits by the hot breath. The gravel turned into red magma when heated, making a sound.
Li Kangtian felt a strong wind that burned mountains and boiled seas blowing towards his face. It was three points stronger than the Yin Sha Gong he used with all his strength, forcing him to subconsciously lean back and dodge!
impossible!
Li Kangtian shouted sharply, suppressing the fear in his heart. Eighty years of skill reached its peak, and the Wan Gu knife turned into a dark green rainbow, covering the sky with poisonous mist, and piercing Zhuoran's heart. I don't believe it!
Even if you have an adventure, can it still be worth the foundation of my eighty years of hard work? !
